gmm.support: very strong support for two groups
gmm.verdict: ΔBIC = +204.6 (one group 11711.3, two groups 11506.7): very strong support for two groups. BIC compares Gaussian shapes, and a single skewed cloud can earn two components, so this is evidence, not proof. Its two groups match the DS / IED call closely (adjusted Rand 0.55, 87% of events the same), so this reads as two kinds of event.

dbic_scale: very strong support for two groups

rule: Pooled over 9 recordings from 9 mice, in pooled raw units: the cluster whose centre has more 500–1000 Hz power is called IED: +18.9 dB against +10.0 dB for the other, which is called DS (722 DS, 720 IED; 11 assigned on 2 of 3 axes (half-width unresolved even at 50 ms)).

scale.why: Pooled raw units, z-scored once across the pool: differences in size between mice stay visible, impedance and placement included.

split_axis.unit: z, 0 at the midpoint, DS negative
